display.purpose: Paper title on reader page only.

dos: Do keep serif to titles and questions; run every action, count, and path in system/mono.
Do use Seal Red once per region; let hairlines and tone do the rest.
Do pair every toast with inline st.success/st.info for critical confirmations.
Do name every icon/text-button with help=.
Do cap figures at 400px wide with a text provenance caption, never a color dot alone.
donts: Don't ship emoji as UI (no nav pictographs, no icon-only buttons, no emoji ledger).
Don't use !important overrides or Streamlit internal [data-testid] selectors.
Don't invent a second accent for buttons; Pine and Ochre are ledger-only.
Don't exceed 75ch in the reading pane or render the full question index past 40 items without collapsing to a select.
Don't add resting shadows, pills, gradients, or glass where the system specifies flat hairline cards.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper light theme + true dark bench theme
Editorial serif for paper/question titles only; system UI everywhere else
Sharp archival corners (2-6px), hairline borders, flat at rest
Custom HTML allowed: library cards, reader header, status ledger replace stock Streamlit cards
Restrained color: accent on <=10% of any screen
narrative.overview: PaperLab is an Operate + Read surface: operators process papers, readers study them. The new UI keeps Streamlit as the app shell but replaces default chrome with custom HTML/CSS: a catalog wall (library), a reading desk (question reader), and a back office (admin/upload/tree). Warm paper grounds, ink text, one seal-red accent used sparingly for primary action and active state.

rules.body: Seal red appears on at most one element per viewport region (one primary button, one active nav item, one open-question marker). Its rarity is the point.
rules.name: The One Seal Rule

rules.body: Red/green/amber status hues live only in the status ledger, badges, and metric deltas - never as button fills or body text.
rules.name: The Ledger Rule

rules.body: Serif speaks the archive (titles, questions). System/mono speaks the instrument (actions, metadata, numbers). They never swap jobs.
rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule

rules.body: Reading-pane prose never exceeds 75ch; wider viewports add margin, not longer lines.
rules.name: The 75ch Rule

rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow that exists without hover, focus, or dialog state is a bug.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule

rules.body: Borders are always 1px Hairline; depth steps change tone or shadow, never border weight.
rules.name: The One-Line Depth Rule
